front: What are the six articles of faith?
back: God (Allah), the angels, the revealed books, the prophets, the Day of Judgement, and divine decree (al-Qadr).

front: Which four books do Muslims name as revealed?
back: The Tawrat (Musa), the Zabur (Dawud), the Injil (Isa) and the Qur'an (Muhammad).

back: God knows and has power over everything, yet people have free will and are responsible for their choices.
